question: Who won the 2025 Booker Prize?
detail: David Szalay's novel "Flesh" was named the winner of the 2025 Booker Prize at a ceremony in London on 10 November 2025, making him the first Hungarian-British author to win.

question: Who won the 2025 Eurovision Song Content?
detail: JJ won the 69th Eurovision Song Contest final in Basel, Switzerland, on 17 May 2025 with 436 points, ahead of Israel (357) and Estonia (356).

question: Who won the 2025 Mercury Music Prize?
detail: Sam Fender won the 2025 Mercury Prize for his third album 'People Watching' at a ceremony at the Utilita Arena in Newcastle on 16 October 2025.

question: Who won the 2025 Turner Prize?
detail: Nnena Kalu won the 2025 Turner Prize (£25,000) at a ceremony at Bradford Grammar School on 9 December 2025, becoming the first artist with a learning disability to win it.

question: Who won the 2026 Giro d'Italia men's general classification?
answer: Jonas Vingegaard (Visma–Lease a Bike), by 5 minutes 22 seconds
detail: Vingegaard won the 2026 Giro d'Italia, finishing 5:22 ahead of Felix Gall (Decathlon CMA CGM), with Jai Hindley third at 6:25, and took five stage wins on the way to completing the Grand Tour set.

question: Who won the 2026 Tour de France men's general classification?
answer: Tadej Pogačar (UAE Team Emirates-XRG) won by 6 minutes 26 seconds over Remco Evenepoel.
detail: Pogačar won his fifth Tour de France title in 73h 56' 26", ahead of Remco Evenepoel (Red Bull-Bora-hansgrohe) by 6:26. Isaac del Toro, his UAE teammate, was third at 9:42.

question: Who won the 2026 Vuelta a Espana men's general classification?
detail: Mas won the 2026 Vuelta a España, finishing 2:15 ahead of runner-up Primož Roglič (Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe) and 2:44 ahead of third-placed Felix Gall, in a winning time of 73h 52' 55".

question: Who won the 2026 FA Cup final?
detail: Manchester City beat Chelsea 1-0 at Wembley on 16 May 2026 to win a record-extending eighth FA Cup, with Antoine Semenyo scoring the only goal.

question: Who won the Scottish League Cup (Premier Sports Cup) final played in 2025?
detail: St Mirren won the Premier Sports Cup final 3–1 against Celtic at Hampden Park on 14 December 2025, their second League Cup win and their first in 12 years.

question: Who won the Premier League title in the season that ended in 2026?
detail: Arsenal won the 2025/26 Premier League, their first title in 22 years and their fourth overall. They were confirmed champions on 19 May 2026 when Manchester City drew 1-1 at Bournemouth, and they lifted the trophy on the final day, 24 May.

question: Who won the 2026 Scottish Cup final?
detail: Celtic beat Dunfermline Athletic 3-1 at Hampden Park, Glasgow on 23 May 2026, which completed the domestic double.

question: Who won the Scottish Premiership title in the season that ended in 2026?
detail: Celtic clinched the 2025–26 Scottish Premiership on 16 May 2026 with a 3–1 final-day home win over Hearts, their fifth consecutive title and 56th Scottish league title overall.

question: Who won the 2026 UEFA Champions League final?
detail: PSG beat Arsenal 4–3 on penalties after a 1–1 draw after extra time at the Puskás Aréna in Budapest on 30 May 2026, retaining the title.

question: Who won the 2026 FIFA World Cup (men's)?
detail: Spain beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time in the final on July 19, 2026 at MetLife Stadium (New York New Jersey Stadium), with Ferran Torres scoring in the 106th minute for Spain's second World Cup title.

question: Who won the 2026 Masters golf tournament?
detail: McIlroy won the 2026 Masters (April 9–12, Augusta National) at 12-under 276, one stroke ahead of Scottie Scheffler, and became the fourth back-to-back Masters champion.

question: Who won the 2026 Open Championship golf?
detail: New Zealand's Ryan Fox won the 154th Open Championship at Royal Birkdale on 19 July 2026. He birdied the 72nd hole to finish 10-under (270), one stroke ahead of Cameron Young, for his first major title.

question: Who won the 2026 PGA Championship (men's golf)?
detail: England's Aaron Rai won the 108th PGA Championship at Aronimink Golf Club on May 17, 2026. He finished at 9-under, three strokes ahead of Jon Rahm and Alex Smalley, for his first major title.

question: Who won the 2026 US Open golf (men's)?
detail: Clark won the 126th U.S. Open at Shinnecock Hills (June 18–21, 2026) by one stroke over Sam Burns, finishing at 4-under 276 for his second U.S. Open title after 2023.

question: Who won Best Actor at the 2026 Academy Awards?
detail: Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for his dual-role performance in "Sinners" at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026, earning his first Oscar.

question: Who won Best Actress at the 2026 Academy Awards?
detail: Jessie Buckley won Best Actress for playing Agnes Shakespeare in "Hamnet" at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026, and was the first Irish woman to win the category.

question: Who won Best Director at the 2026 Academy Awards?
detail: Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Director for "One Battle After Another" at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026, and it was his first Oscar win.

question: Which film won Best Picture at the 2026 Academy Awards?
detail: Paul Thomas Anderson's "One Battle After Another" won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026, and took six Oscars in total, including Best Director.

question: Which horse won the 2026 Grand National at Aintree?
answer: I Am Maximus, ridden by Paul Townend and trained by Willie Mullins
detail: I Am Maximus, the 9/2 favourite, won the Grand National at Aintree on 11 April 2026. It was his second win after 2024, and he was owned by J. P. McManus (per Wikipedia) or Claudio Michael Grech (per ESPN).

question: Who won the 2026 men's Six Nations?
answer: France won the 2026 men's Six Nations. It was neither a Grand Slam nor a Triple Crown for France. Wales finished last and took the Wooden Spoon.
detail: France secured a second straight title when Thomas Ramos kicked a last-kick penalty to beat England 48-46, finishing two table points ahead of Ireland. Ireland won the Triple Crown, no team won the Grand Slam, and Wales finished last for the third year running.

question: Who won the 2026 World Snooker Championship at the Crucible?
answer: Wu Yize won the 2026 World Snooker Championship, beating Shaun Murphy 18-17 in the final.
detail: Wu Yize, 22, of China beat runner-up Shaun Murphy 18-17 in a final-frame decider at the Crucible on 4 May 2026. It was the first world final to go to a deciding frame since 2002.

question: Who won the 2026 Australian Open men's singles?
detail: Alcaraz beat Novak Djokovic 2-6, 6-2, 6-3, 7-5 in the final at Rod Laver Arena on 1 February 2026, winning his first Australian Open title and completing the career Grand Slam.

question: Who won the 2026 Australian Open women's singles?
detail: Rybakina of Kazakhstan beat world No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 4-6, 6-4 in the final in Melbourne on 31 January 2026, winning her first Australian Open title and second Grand Slam.

question: Who won the 2026 French Open men's singles?
detail: Zverev beat Italy's Flavio Cobolli 6-1, 4-6, 6-4, 6-7(5-7), 6-1 in the final on 7 June 2026, winning his first Grand Slam title.

question: Who won the 2026 French Open women's singles?
detail: Andreeva, the No. 8 seed, beat Polish qualifier Maja Chwalińska 6-3, 6-2 in the final on 6 June 2026 to win her first Grand Slam title.

question: Who won the 2026 US Open men's singles?
detail: Top seed Alexander Zverev of Germany beat No. 8 seed Ben Shelton 6-3, 7-6(2), 5-7, 6-2 in the final on September 13, 2026, to win his first US Open title and second major after the 2026 French Open.

question: Who won the 2026 US Open women's singles?
detail: Rybakina of Kazakhstan beat two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 in the final at Arthur Ashe Stadium on September 12, 2026, for her third Grand Slam title.

question: Who won the 2026 Wimbledon men's singles?
detail: Defending champion Jannik Sinner of Italy beat Alexander Zverev 6–7(7), 7–6(2), 6–3, 6–4 in the final on 12 July 2026, winning his second Wimbledon title and fifth Grand Slam title.

question: Who won the 2026 Wimbledon women's singles?
detail: Ninth seed Linda Nosková beat fellow Czech Karolína Muchová 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 in the final on 11 July 2026 to win her first Grand Slam title.

question: Who won the 2026 series of The Apprentice UK (BBC)?
answer: Karishma Vijay, founder of the skincare-infused cosmetics brand Kishkin
detail: Vijay won Series 20 of The Apprentice UK in the final on 16 April 2026, beating runner-up Pascha Myhill, and received Lord Sugar's £250,000 investment in her beauty brand Kishkin.

question: Who won the 2026 series of Britain's Got Talent (ITV)?
detail: A choir of farmers, the first choir ever to win Britain's Got Talent, was crowned winner of series 19 in the live final on 30 May 2026, ahead of runner-up Celestial, a drone display group.

question: Who won the 2025 series of Celebrity Traitors UK (BBC)?
detail: Alan Carr won the first series of The Celebrity Traitors (finale 6 November 2025) as the last remaining Traitor, taking £87,500 for the charity Neuroblastoma UK.

question: Who won the 2025 series of I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here! (UK, ITV)?
answer: Angryginge (Angry Ginge, real name Morgan Burtwistle) won as King of the Jungle. Tom Read Wilson was runner-up (2nd) and Shona McGarty finished 3rd.
detail: Angryginge won the 7 December 2025 final with about 53% of roughly 13 million votes, ahead of Tom Read Wilson (25%) and Shona McGarty (22%).

question: Who won the 2026 summer series of Love Island UK (ITV2)?
answer: Winners: Julia Majchrzak & Lorenzo Alessi. Runners-up: Jasmine Müller & Kavan Murphy.
detail: Julia and Lorenzo won the Love Island UK series 13 final on 27 July 2026 and shared the £50,000 prize. Jasmine and Kavan came second, and Angelista Gunda and Simba Kudyiwa came third.

question: Who won the 2025 series of Strictly Come Dancing (BBC)?
answer: Karen Carney and her professional partner Carlos Gu won Strictly Come Dancing 2025. The runners-up were George Clarke with Alexis Warr, and Amber Davies with Nikita Kuzmin.
detail: Karen Carney, the former England footballer, and Carlos Gu were crowned champions in the final on 20 December 2025 on BBC One, beating YouTuber George Clarke (partnered with Alexis Warr) and Love Island's Amber Davies (partnered with Nikita Kuzmin).

question: Who won the 2026 series of The Traitors UK (BBC, civilian version)?
answer: Rachel Duffy and Stephen Libby (both Traitors) won series 4 of The Traitors UK, splitting a £95,750 prize pot (£47,875 each).
detail: The series 4 final aired on BBC One on 23 January 2026, when Traitors Rachel Duffy and Stephen Libby stayed loyal to each other and became the first pair of Traitors to win together, beating runner-up Jack Butler; one AOL report says £97,750, but Yahoo and Hello! give £95,750, which matches the £47,875 each.

question: Who is the current Archbishop of Canterbury?
detail: Dame Sarah Mullally became the 106th Archbishop of Canterbury and the first woman in the role. Her election was confirmed on 28 January 2026 and she was installed at Canterbury Cathedral on 25 March 2026.

question: Who is the current UK Chancellor of the Exchequer?
detail: John Healey has been Chancellor of the Exchequer since 20 July 2026, when new Prime Minister Andy Burnham appointed him to replace Rachel Reeves.

question: Who is the current Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, and when did they take office?
answer: Andy Burnham, who took office on 20 July 2026
detail: Burnham became Prime Minister on 20 July 2026 after meeting King Charles III. He replaced Keir Starmer, who had agreed to step down, and is the 59th person to hold the office.
